Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
With the new clarification on "Fishing" (tapping the Barrens to
search for a Sudden Reversal, etc), how does this interact with
Rotschreck?

Two specific examples:

1) I block an action.  I strike Breath of the Dragon, and the card
I replace it with is Rotschreck.  Can I play Rotschreck?

2) I block an action.  I strike Breath of the Dragon.  I tap the
Barrens and my new card is Rotschreck.  Can I play Rotschreck?

Since Rotschreck's timing is "as damage is attempted" as opposed to
"as card is played", I'm not sure what the window looks like here.

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> 1) I block an action.  I strike Breath of the Dragon, and the card
> I replace it with is Rotschreck.  Can I play Rotschreck?
> 
> 2) I block an action.  I strike Breath of the Dragon.  I tap the
> Barrens and my new card is Rotschreck.  Can I play Rotschreck?
> 
> Since Rotschreck's timing is "as damage is attempted" as opposed to
> "as card is played", I'm not sure what the window looks like here.

Yes to both.

The new timing window only really affects "as played" cards, like Direct 
Intervention.  Rotschreck isn't "as played".

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: vtesrep@white-wolf.com
Messages.Body:
> With the new clarification on "Fishing" (tapping the Barrens to
> search for a Sudden Reversal, etc), how does this interact with
> Rotschreck?

It doesn't. Rotschreck is not a "cancel a card as it is played" effect.

> Two specific examples:

> 1) I block an action. I strike Breath of the Dragon, and the card
> I replace it with is Rotschreck. Can I play > Rotschreck?

Yes.

> 2) I block an action. I strike Breath of the Dragon. I tap the
> Barrens and my new card is Rotschreck. Can > I play Rotschreck?

Yes.
